newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico upgraded to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico upgraded to neutral.

text.p: -- Smith Barney said it had upgraded Mexico to neutral from underweight in its model portfolio of Latin American stocks.

-- "Interest rates appear poised to decline slowly from here, ending a primary reason we went to underweight for the fourth quarter of this year," analyst James Barrineau wrote in a report released late on Tuesday.
-- "Additionally, we see a solid potential for upside surprises in the economy.

-- "Nevertheless, it is unclear whether the macroeconomic gains will translate into better earnings expectations. Additionally the tax loss carry forward expirations arising from the peso devaluation" could harm some earnings releases next year, he wrote.

-- "Finally, we are entering a political season where there is a good chance the ruling (Institutional Revolutionary Party) could lose control of the lower house of Congress, which would be an historical shift of power."
-- Smith Barney alloted Mexico 20 percent of its Latin American portfolio.
